items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: And Gus Akin was with me and we said, "Yeah."

ctx.x: She cleaned him, she cleaned him. So it's 6:00 o'clock in the morning and she said, "Bouchand, you our trumpet player hungry?" And Gus Akin was with me and we said, "Yeah." So she went out in the kitchen to fix some bacon and eggs and I said, "Gus, I'm going." He said, "Oh, you can't do that," and I said, "I'm going." While she's fixing the eggs I got my horn under one arm, my hand bag under the other, and put my pistol inside of my case and I ran 15 blocks to the railroad station. Flew through the door and went…
